pages.title: Mekong Giant Catfish
pages.text: The Mekong giant catfish ($(o)Pangasianodon gigas$()) lives in the Mekong River of Southeast Asia.$(br2)It is a plain grey and white fish with a broad head, small low-set eyes and, as an adult, no whiskers or teeth. It grows up to 3 metres long and feeds mainly on algae.$(br2)A 293-kilogram female caught in Thailand in 2005 is one of the largest freshwater fish ever recorded. It is now critically endangered.
